exposure: modified World Health Organization classification of CHD severity
cohort: The study included 162 deliveries among 113 women with CHD and 321 deliveries among 321 women without CHD.
finding: Women with Congenital Heart Disease experience increased cardiac and obstetric morbidity and longer peripartum hospital stays compared to controls, with longer stays associated with disease severity.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery and assisted vaginal delivery were more frequent in women with CHD, contributing to increased obstetric events.
